summary: This 8-K reports that Charlton Aria Acquisition Corp, a blank-check SPAC, extended its initial business combination deadline to July 25, 2026 by having its sponsor deposit $850,000 into the trust account. The sponsor also issued a $500,000 working capital promissory note for prior and future loans. Both notes are unsecured, non-interest bearing (default interest at T-bill rate), payable upon deal completion or liquidation. This is a routine SPAC extension filing; the company is the issuer. Watch for whether a target is announced by the new deadline to avoid liquidation.
